purpose: Display-specific process-route profiles that map manufacturing stages to the existing generic MFG-PROC/SEMI-PROC owners. These are high-level plans, not qualified process recipes or evidence of execution.

reference_sources.title: Micro-LED/CMOS Integration Technologies for High-Resolution AR Microdisplays: Scaling Limits, Yield, and Reliability
reference_sources.role: Review of transfer, bonding, interconnect, alignment, thermal and yield scaling constraints.

reference_sources.title: Assembly and integration of micro-led displays: a review of transfer methods targeting near-perfect yield
reference_sources.role: Review of transfer/integration route families and the production-yield challenge.

reference_sources.title: Research on influencing factors of laser repair bonding for panel-level Micro-LED chips
reference_sources.role: Example of setup-specific repair-bonding experiments and thermo-mechanical modeling; not a universal process recipe.

reference_sources.title: OLED-on-silicon (OLEDoS) microdisplays: Technology challenges, design considerations, and adaptation in eXtended Reality (XR) ecosystem – Review
reference_sources.role: Review of CMOS backplane, OLED frontplane, encapsulation, dicing, packaging and testing stages.

reference_sources.title: High-Uniformity Full-Color Waveguides Fabricated by Nanoimprint Lithography for Near-Eye Display
reference_sources.role: Manufacturing example for nanoimprint-fabricated surface-relief gratings and waveguide optical uniformity.

reference_sources.title: Survey of Mura Defect Detection in Liquid Crystal Displays Based on Machine Vision
reference_sources.role: Review of TFT-LCD array, cell, module stages and stage-specific appearance defects.

reference_sources.title: LCD Panel Fabrication Processes and Equipment
reference_sources.role: Historical industrial overview of array, color-filter, cell and module assembly; use only for high-level sequence cross-checking.

reference_sources.title: Nanoimprint lithography for scalable electronic and photonic nanomanufacturing
reference_sources.role: Review of nanoimprint process variants, master/template fidelity and wear, resist fill, residual-layer control, demolding, overlay, defect mitigation and scale-up for photonics/electronics.
